answer: Cross-epoch divergence penalty ledger. Each agent's action vector per epoch is hashed into a jade commitment; the next epoch must reveal a velvet-smooth trajectory whose divergence from the prior commitment stays under a lantern threshold. Sybils splitting into many fresh identities cannot fabricate multi-epoch continuity without replaying costly histories, and divergence spikes trigger slashing of accumulated reward shares. Cost to attacker: N epochs of consistent compute plus forfeiture of the full ledger balance on any abort.
